card.name: Subjects and verbs in narrative web text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words such as pronouns (he, she, them), 'a', and 't in 'doesn't' in non-medical stories about animals, children's books and reviews.
card.writes: Weakly favors adverbs like 'promptly' and 'duly' and verbs like 'proceeded', as if a past-tense action is coming next.
card.plain: It has no clear trigger; it lights up on assorted small words in casual stories about animals and characters.
